Definition: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention; to be male
BiblicalUsage: 1) to remember, recall, call to mind; 1a) (Qal) to remember, recall; 1b) (Niphal) to be brought to remembrance, be remembered, be thought of, be brought to mind; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to cause to remember, remind; 1c2) to cause to be remembered, keep in remembrance; 1c3) to mention; 1c4) to record; 1c5) to make a memorial, make remembrance
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
